title: Wake up, Sleeping Beauty
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Timid high schooler Tetsu Misato takes a job at the eerie Karasawa estate, where the family's only daughter, Shizu, is kept hidden. Different personalities, which seem to be spirits of the dead, appear through Shizu, and Tetsu must decide how to care for her and whether the real Shizu will ever return. A six-volume shojo drama from Kodansha's Dessert.
life_message: Patient love and a caring household can help a wounded person come back to life.

content.note: Eerie mansion and ghost-like personalities (AniList blurb and Ghost tag).
